p: he did not say it with regard to a gift … But it is taught … Like the gift offerings … he has vowed with regard to … a nazirite or … an offering; … Teach … He has volunteered with regard to … a nazirite or

he did not say it with regard to a gift offering. The Gemara asks: But it is taught in the mishna that if one said: Like the gift offerings of the virtuous, he has vowed with regard to becoming a nazirite or bringing an offering; this indicates that the virtuous vow to become nazirites and bring offerings. The Gemara answers: Teach the mishna in the following emended formulation: He has volunteered with regard to becoming a nazirite or
